# Efetivo-2-SGB-2027
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="pt-BR"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Controle de Efetivo · 5º GB - 2º SGB</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600&family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#070D1A;--s:#0E1A2E;--s2:#16263F;--b:rgba(148,180,255,.15);--t:#EAF1FF;--m:#8EA3C7;--r:#F0524F;--y:#FBBF24;--g:#34D399;--bl:#60A5FA;--br:#22D3EE;color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){:root:not([data-theme=dark]){--bg:#F1F5FB;--s:#fff;--s2:#E8EEF8;--b:rgba(0,0,0,.12);--t:#101828;--m:#52627F;--y:#B27800;--r:#C42222;--g:#12805C;--br:#0B7285;color-scheme:light}}
:root[data-theme=light]{--bg:#F1F5FB;--s:#fff;--s2:#E8EEF8;--b:rgba(0,0,0,.12);--t:#101828;--m:#52627F;--y:#B27800;--r:#C42222;--g:#12805C;--br:#0B7285;color-scheme:light}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--t);font:15px/1.45 Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif}
h1,h2,h3,.n{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif;margin:0}
header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#071A3A,#0B5C8A);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:2px solid var(--br)}
header .lg{height:48px;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:2px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:10px}header h1{font-size:28px;display:inline}header small{display:block;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:11px;opacity:.85;text-transform:uppercase}
.hr{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.hq{display:flex;gap:14px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;text-align:center}.hq b{display:block;font:700 22px 'Barlow Condensed'}.hq small{font-size:10px}
nav{display:flex;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 12px;background:var(--s);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
nav button{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;color:var(--m);font:600 14px 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
nav button.on{color:var(--br);border-color:var(--br)}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--y);outline-offset:2px}
main{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 14px 40px}.p{display:none}.p.on{display:block}
.g{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));margin-bottom:14px}.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr))}.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr))}
.c{background:var(--s);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:8px;padding:14px}.c h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.k{border-top:3px solid var(--br)}.k.y{border-color:var(--y)}.k.g{border-color:var(--g)}.k.b{border-color:var(--bl)}
.n{font-size:42px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}.l{color:var(--m);font-size:13px;margin-top:4px}.ct{text-align:center}
.bn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;text-align:center}.bn img{height:80px;background:#fff;border-radius:4px}.bn small{display:block;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--m);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase}.bn h2{font-size:30px;text-transform:uppercase}
.pb{height:10px;background:var(--s2);border-radius:5px;margin-top:12px;overflow:hidden}.pb i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--br),var(--g))}
.br{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,30%) 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;margin:7px 0}.br>span:first-child{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600}.br>span:nth-child(2){background:var(--s2);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:block}.br i{display:block;height:12px;border-radius:6px}
.f{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}.f input,.f select{background:var(--s);color:var(--t);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font:inherit}.f input{flex:1;min-width:200px}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}th,td{padding:7px 10px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--b);white-space:nowrap}th{color:var(--m);font-weight:500}tbody tr.cl{cursor:pointer}tbody tr:hover{background:var(--s2)}
.t{display:inline-block;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:var(--s2)}.t.r{color:var(--r)}.t.y{color:var(--y)}.t.g{color:var(--g)}.t.m{color:var(--m)}
.AZUL{color:var(--bl)}.VERDE{color:var(--g)}.AMARELA{color:var(--y)}.ADM,.LSV{color:var(--m)}
.ch{display:inline-block;background:var(--s2);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 8px;margin:2px;font-size:13px}
dialog{background:var(--s);color:var(--t);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:10px;max-width:560px;width:calc(100% - 24px);max-height:85vh}dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(0,0,0,.6)}dialog h2{font-size:26px}dialog p{margin:4px 0;color:var(--m)}dialog li{margin:3px 0}
.ai{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}.ai .n{font-size:26px;width:44px;color:var(--y)}.ai.h{background:var(--s2)}
.tw input,.tw select,dialog input{background:var(--s2);color:var(--t);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:5px;padding:4px 6px;font:inherit;max-width:170px}
.bt{background:var(--s2);color:var(--t);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 12px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.bt.pm{background:var(--br);color:#04212B;border-color:var(--br);font-weight:600}
.lb{border:1px solid #000;background:#fff;color:#000;padding:3mm;font-size:11pt;overflow:hidden}.lb .ln{font:700 20pt 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif}
#pr{display:none}@media print{body.pri>*:not(#pr){display:none!important}body.pri #pr{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4mm}}
.ph{height:46px;width:36px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;vertical-align:middle}.ai .n{color:var(--br)}

/* tema do emblema do 5º GB: vermelho, laranja, amarelo e azul-marinho */
:root{--bg:#0B0A1C;--s:#15132B;--s2:#221E45;--b:rgba(255,235,160,.13);--t:#F7F2E7;--m:#A9A6C4;--r:#EF4444;--y:#F6C90E;--g:#34D399;--bl:#8C93FF;--br:#F6C90E}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){:root:not([data-theme=dark]){--bg:#FBF6EA;--s:#fff;--s2:#F3EBD6;--b:rgba(60,40,0,.14);--t:#1C1A14;--m:#6B6450;--r:#C62828;--y:#A87400;--g:#12805C;--bl:#3B3FA8;--br:#B38600}}
body{background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 12% -8%,rgba(214,40,40,.35),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(800px 420px at 92% -5%,rgba(246,201,14,.18),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 500px at 50% 112%,rgba(80,70,200,.2),transparent 60%),var(--bg);background-attachment:fixed}
header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#7F0F12 0%,#C1121F 38%,#E8590C 72%,#F6C90E 125%);border-bottom:3px solid #F6C90E;padding:14px 22px;text-align:center}
header h1{display:block;font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,78px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.hl img,.lgph{height:clamp(64px,10vw,104px);width:auto;max-width:160px;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:4px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.lgph{width:96px;border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.75);background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);color:#fff;font:700 20px 'Barlow Condensed';cursor:pointer}
.ht small{display:block;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.92}.ht .hr{justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}header .hr small{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;display:inline}
nav button.on{color:var(--y);border-color:var(--r)}.k{border-top:3px solid var(--r)}.k.y{border-color:var(--y)}
.bt.pm{background:var(--y);color:#241a00;border-color:var(--y)}
#lg{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px}.lc{background:var(--s);border:1px solid var(--b);border-top:4px solid var(--r);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;max-width:380px;width:100%;text-align:center}
.lc img{height:96px;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:4px}.lc h1{font-size:46px;margin:10px 0 0}.lc p{color:var(--m)}
.lc input{width:100%;padding:12px;font-size:18px;text-align:center;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--b);background:var(--s2);color:var(--t);letter-spacing:2px}
.lc button{margin-top:10px;width:100%;padding:12px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--y);color:#241a00;font:700 18px 'Barlow Condensed';cursor:pointer}#ms{min-height:22px;margin-top:10px;color:var(--r)}
@media(max-width:640px){header{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-areas:"a c" "b b"}header .hl:first-child{grid-area:a;justify-self:start}header .hl:last-child{grid-area:c;justify-self:end}header .ht{grid-area:b}}
</style></head><body>
<div id="lg"><div class="lc"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="5º GB"><h1>5º GB - 2º SGB</h1><p>Acesso restrito à Administração</p>
<input id="cpf" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Digite seu CPF" maxlength="14" aria-label="CPF"><button id="go">Entrar</button><div id="ms" role="alert"></div></div></div>
<div id="app"></div>
<script>(()=>{const BLOB={"s":"AquyoshkbkYiuQLYb2OV2g==","w":[{"i":"fn3i7ACgVYXmDmmw","c":"AMh6IwO9JWKyebKgv/ng8tOt+5mSxgOrcr54CO0FAw9hPcAsQk+NBJAzm2pUSi/C"},{"i":"5YzXKe1xNpLvGx4q","c":"XZgBjhM15CogjFiXdSfXq/mGvFeLdUOlkaeDPwVOGFTwXqbZXUITJ0Qz6noXjpmm"},{"i":"DnpTF0dkv8xyzb5h","c":"RO3v+HXSicupaN/NO7KRHmytvu9VdZZIRYjNSBJbDUXatEXuHRAseRIAYT3D3FcM"},{"i":"fwk+Mbf3p7m7/I0r","c":"OcQkrAFdai3Hljt/D/C7Gh/Du2tcx/5HB/f5MLMkk5jmGr63xbp3r+9d1zR49wPg"},{"i":"y9x4D/5sqpZLgg3v","c":"uyEzeX6M9KAdKyvoNgRUEf3prW19zN/U0jDhjK3W1eGLGe9+9YoXJib++RMNlg0R"},{"i":"VshH05KKXw4B5B4D","c":"uBweabvnn7lZbg8cPQFKS5//+fEoWuZwsq3VNo59fFMULCZolB9qB4sgDz2uQi43"},{"i":"Tasum2n4EScEMyXE","c":"oCg2HcyHb87bp1kWVuD0M0NqzmOT13dyD4JMewX/JcSw0ZvzWCLEo612xwtsdvBf"},{"i":"lnF3ykYm5kd3HyLp","c":"B7+e6cLtQKwAA9khfs3e0vaO6m5Cb4WKV0MXPntXC7l/DtQ08i7ZyPk3hDTeXYT/"},{"i":"fqQ5b4ZOP+WBJpsc","c":"mTv/y7hX5los0LXQgc3I5FCYUSlXKOPai6ddOBQtNJT6WlMm7mXXIzYttq/JHEzI"},{"i":"WnYplaCI7k4a/bh4","c":"PEXbVRy/d3xGGTcfPpyLJ/TS/tYW24I9IW1dICDL89U3IJhTxJGT5/eQs++aGLEg"}],"i":"Xu+BTjDrlVCoil3U","p":""},enc=new TextEncoder(),dec=new TextDecoder(),g=i=>document.getElementById(i);
const b64=b=>{let s='';new Uint8Array(b).forEach(x=>s+=String.fromCharCode(x));return btoa(s)},ub=s=>Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
const kd=async(c,s)=>crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:ub(s),iterations:200000,hash:'SHA-256'},await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',enc.encode(c),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey']),{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['encrypt','decrypt']);
async function unlock(raw){const K=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',raw,'AES-GCM',false,['decrypt']);
 const P=JSON.parse(dec.decode(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:ub(BLOB.i)},K,ub(BLOB.p))));
 window._cr={b64,ub,kd,enc,dec,salt:BLOB.s,w:BLOB.w,K:new Uint8Array(raw),p:P};window.DATA=P.d;g('app').innerHTML=P.h;g('lg').remove();
 const s=document.createElement('script');s.textContent=P.j;document.body.appendChild(s)}
async function byCpf(c){const w=await kd(c,BLOB.s);for(const x of BLOB.w){try{return await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:ub(x.i)},w,ub(x.c))}catch(e){}}return null}
async function enter(){const c=g('cpf').value.replace(/\D/g,''),m=g('ms');if(!window.crypto||!crypto.subtle){m.textContent='Abra este arquivo por um endereço https (link publicado).';return}
 if(c.length!=11){m.textContent='Digite os 11 números do CPF.';return}m.textContent='Verificando…';g('go').disabled=true;
 try{const raw=await byCpf(c);if(!raw){m.textContent='CPF não autorizado.';g('go').disabled=false;return}try{sessionStorage.setItem('k',b64(raw))}catch(e){}await unlock(raw)}catch(e){m.textContent='Não foi possível abrir.';g('go').disabled=false}}
g('go').onclick=enter;g('cpf').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key=='Enter')enter()};
(async()=>{try{const k=sessionStorage.getItem('k');if(k&&crypto.subtle)await unlock(ub(k).buffer)}catch(e){try{sessionStorage.removeItem('k')}catch(x){}}})();
})()</script></body></html>
